zh: 成交量大的币更容易上涨
en: Coins with high trading volume are more likely to rise.

zh: 成交额很小的币后面表现更好
en: Coins that trade very little in dollar terms do better afterwards.

zh: 成交量比自己平时放大很多的币，后面容易继续涨
en: A coin whose volume has jumped well above its own usual level tends to keep rising.

zh: 突然放量往往是见顶信号，之后容易跌
en: A sudden burst of volume usually marks a top, so the coin tends to fall afterwards.

zh: 成交量持续萎缩的币，之后容易反弹
en: A coin whose volume has been drying up tends to bounce afterwards.

zh: 单位成交额推动价格变动更大（流动性差）的币，预期收益更高
en: Coins whose price moves more per dollar traded, meaning they are illiquid, earn higher returns.

zh: 流动性好、单位成交额几乎推不动价格的币更容易跑赢
en: Liquid coins, whose price barely moves per dollar traded, tend to outperform.

zh: 每天成交笔数多的币表现更好
en: Coins with many trades per day tend to do better.

zh: 成交笔数突然比平时多很多的币，之后容易跌
en: When a coin's number of trades jumps far above normal, it tends to fall afterwards.

zh: 平均每笔成交金额大，说明大资金在参与，看涨
en: A large average trade size means big money is involved, which is bullish.

zh: 平均每笔金额小、散户主导的币，后面跑得更好
en: Coins dominated by small trades, where retail leads, perform better afterwards.

zh: 主动买入占比高的币更容易涨
en: When aggressive buyers make up a larger share of trading, the coin is more likely to rise.

zh: 主动买入过猛之后买盘耗尽，价格容易回落
en: After heavy aggressive buying the demand is exhausted, so the price tends to fall back.

zh: 最近一段时间持续被主动卖出的币，之后容易反弹
en: A coin that has seen persistent aggressive selling lately tends to bounce.

zh: 昨天跌得多的币今天容易反弹
en: Coins that fell a lot yesterday tend to bounce.

zh: 过去一周涨太多的币之后容易回吐
en: Coins that ran up too much over the past week tend to give it back.

zh: 过去一个月涨得好的币会继续涨
en: Coins that did well over the past month keep rising.

zh: 过去三个月最强的币会继续领涨
en: The strongest coins of the past three months keep leading.

zh: 当天收盘远高于开盘的币，后面还会涨
en: Coins that close far above their open tend to keep rising.

zh: 接近最近新高的币更强，会继续涨
en: A coin trading near its recent high is strong and keeps rising.

zh: 价格远高于均线的币涨过头了，之后容易跌
en: A coin far above its moving average has overshot and tends to fall.

zh: 波动小的币后面收益更好
en: Low-volatility coins earn better returns than volatile ones.

zh: 波动越大的币，后面收益越高
en: The more volatile a coin has been, the higher its later return.

zh: 日收益总是偏离市场平均的币，后面表现差
en: A coin whose daily returns keep straying far from the market average does worse afterwards.

zh: 最近出现过单日极端波动的币，之后容易跑输
en: A coin that recently had an extreme one-day move tends to underperform.

zh: 振幅大的币之后容易跌
en: Coins with a wide daily high-low range tend to fall afterwards.

zh: 振幅放大说明关注度上升，之后容易涨
en: A widening daily range signals growing attention, which leads to gains.

zh: 收盘接近全天最高价，说明买方占优，看涨
en: Closing near the day's high shows buyers are in control, which is bullish.

zh: 上影线长说明上方抛压重，看跌
en: A long upper shadow shows selling pressure above, which is bearish.

zh: 下影线长说明下方有人接盘，看涨
en: A long lower shadow shows buyers stepping in below, which is bullish.

zh: 总是收在全天低位的币超跌了，之后容易反弹
en: A coin that keeps closing near the day's low is oversold and tends to bounce.
